fields.value: Reuse prepared runtimes and model weights across inference rentals

Problem: repeated inference jobs pay dependency preparation and model-download costs even when immutable inputs are unchanged. Benefit all model-policy callers, including small trained policies and large LLMs.

Outcome: provide an explicit reusable preparation/cache path with truthful cache-state and transfer receipts across job and rental lifetimes. Reuse existing verified artifact downloads (completed Task 88f96c); do not reimplement that cache. MTG-121 owns Manabot's allocation-to-training startup experiment and maintained-image choice; coordinate with it rather than duplicate or alter its budget/attempts.

Acceptance: identify artifacts by source/model revision, digest and runtime compatibility; demonstrate valid reuse, corruption/incompatibility rejection, interrupted preparation and documented eviction/lifetime. Dependencies and native extensions must not rebuild after preparation unnecessarily. Separate provision/image acquisition, transfer/verification, installation, process/model load and first-result costs. Evaluate persistent storage and prebuilt environments first; compare Modal's volume and CPU/GPU snapshot mechanisms and record whether snapshot support is worth implementing. An honest defer of snapshots is acceptable; caching must not silently keep paid hardware alive. Preserve cost caps, cleanup, provenance and credential isolation. Use controlled fixtures/counting checks; never induce artificial host load.

References: [https://modal.com/docs/guide/model-weights](<https://modal.com/docs/guide/model-weights>) and [https://modal.com/docs/guide/memory-snapshots](<https://modal.com/docs/guide/memory-snapshots>).

MTG-185's Etude run 4c2a54fdfaac completed one Qwen3.5-9B BF16 game on an L4 against seeded random: 160 valid initial model decisions, no repairs/fallbacks, 308 Commands replayed exactly. Cold model acquisition plus verification 87.52s; load 10.04s; game 280.55s; median decision 1.956s; maximum prompt 4,329 tokens. Device samples peaked at 22,494/23,034 MiB. This does not establish worst-case 8,192-token capacity or concurrent-request fit. Model/tokenizer revision c202236235762e1c871ad0ccb60c8ee5ba337b9a; Transformers 5.3.0. The worker retained one model across decisions, but no prefix state across requests; its remote cache ended with the rental. Original receipts remain in the MTG-185 checkout at .runs/llm/l4-result and the working design in scratch/llm-finetune.md; copy necessary evidence into this Task's checkout before execution.

Requested by Jack Heart on 2026-10-26 in the MTG-185 conversation while comparing Modal and Resin with our inference stack. Capture only: this Task does not itself authorize a new paid run or inherit another Task's spending allowance. Before paid validation, declare the required hardware, time, total cost, cleanup and attempt limits under the applicable execution authorization. Preserve model/world identity, viewer-safe input, complete legal action space and revision-bound Command execution.
